## Summary

[Partial] Run a heavy-gauge wire with an inline fuse to an auxiliary fuse block. [t964]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Run a heavy-gauge wire from the battery to an auxiliary fuse block.
2. Install a large inline fuse on the positive side of that connection.

_Procedure reported by [t964]._

## Parts

- Auxiliary fuse block, e.g., Blue-Sea ST Blade [t964]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use the fused power output from the block to feed multiple accessories like lights, CB radios, fridges, or gaming systems. [t964]
- Consider using a relay for high-draw items connected downstream. [t964]
